title: lycopodium clavatum f. incurvum
intro: Lycopodium clavatum f. incurvum, commonly known as the "Incurved Club Moss", is a variant of the Lycopodium clavatum plant, belonging to the Lycopodiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium clavatum f. incurvum include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
